D: Michael tightens his grip on the empire while young Vito's rise plays out in old New York.
P: Serve the mains when the story moves to Havana for New Year's Eve.
S: young Vito's Little Italy, the festa going on outside

Cook arborio in stock with saffron and parmesan, spread on a tray and chill overnight. Wrap golf balls of rice around a peas and beef ragù filling with a cube of mozzarella, flour, egg, crumb, fry at 175C until deep gold.
ham, roast pork, swiss and pickles, pressed flat for the Havana trip

Split slider rolls, smear with mustard, layer leg ham, sliced mojo pork, Swiss and dill pickle. Brush tops with butter and press in a heavy pan over medium heat, a second pan on top, until the cheese melts and the bread crisps.
for the lakeside compound where it all goes cold
Flake 2 hot-smoked trout fillets, blitz half with 150g cream cheese, crème fraîche, lemon and horseradish, fold the rest through for texture. Dill and cracked pepper, water crackers on the side.
M: ricotta and a mozzarella crust, the kind of thing a young family stretches over a week

Cook ziti 3 minutes short of done. Toss with a slow tomato and Italian sausage sauce, layer with ricotta seasoned with parmesan, nutmeg and parsley, top with torn mozzarella. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until blistered.
garlic, citrus, black beans and rice for New Year's Eve in Havana

Marinate pork shoulder overnight in sour orange (or orange and lime), a whole head of garlic, cumin and oregano. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until it pulls, then crisp at 220C. Black beans with sofrito and white rice.
W: the sponge iced like Cuba, cut and shared around the table

Bake a vanilla butter sponge in a slab tin. Cut into a rough island shape, cover with a thin crumb coat then pale green buttercream. Pipe "Happy Birthday" across it and slice at the table while everyone talks business.
K: rum, lime and sugar, shaken hard the Havana way
Shake 60ml white rum, 25ml fresh lime and 15ml sugar syrup hard with plenty of ice, double strain into a chilled coupe. No fruit, no blender.

edition.cue: Serve the mains when the story moves to Havana for New Year's Eve.

s.note: Saffron rice balls filled with beef ragù, peas and mozzarella.
s.how: Cook 300g arborio rice in 900ml stock with a pinch of saffron until thick, stir in 40g parmesan and chill overnight on a tray. Brown 150g beef mince with 50g frozen peas and 2 tbsp passata. Wrap golf balls of rice around a spoon of filling and a cube of mozzarella. Roll in flour, 2 beaten eggs and 100g breadcrumbs, and fry at 175C until deep gold.

s.note: Pressed slider rolls of ham, mojo pork, Swiss cheese and pickle.
s.how: Split 8 slider rolls and smear the cut sides with 2 tbsp yellow mustard. Layer with 150g leg ham, 150g sliced roast pork, 8 slices Swiss cheese and sliced dill pickles. Brush the tops with 30g melted butter and press in a heavy pan over medium heat with a second pan on top, 3 minutes a side, until the cheese melts.

m.note: Baked ziti with sausage tomato sauce, seasoned ricotta and blistered mozzarella.
m.how: Squeeze 500g Italian sausages from their skins and brown, add 700ml passata and simmer 30 minutes. Cook 500g ziti or penne 3 minutes short of done. Mix 400g ricotta with 50g grated parmesan, nutmeg and parsley. Layer pasta, sauce and ricotta in a baking dish, top with 200g torn mozzarella and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until blistered.

w.note: Vanilla slab cake iced pale green and cut like an island.
w.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 200g caster sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour with 100ml milk. Bake in a lined slab tin at 180C for 30 minutes and cool. Trim into a rough island shape. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and a few drops of green food colouring, spread thinly then again, pipe happy birthday across and slice at the table.

d.note: White rum, fresh lime and sugar shaken hard and served ice cold.
d.how: Make sugar syrup by dissolving 60g caster sugar in 60ml hot water and cooling. For each drink shake 60ml white rum, 25ml fresh lime juice and 15ml syrup hard with plenty of ice, then double strain into a chilled coupe. Makes four, with 240ml rum and about 4 limes.
